rationale: Create one canonical Illinois operating wind portfolio and keep Bright Stalk and Harvest Ridge as subordinate projects. Record the directly evidenced current 80% Schroders Greencoat-managed and 20% EDPR ownership split without inventing managed-fund or holdco names.

supports: The final upsize closed on September 8, 2021

evidence.purpose: Initial closing and portfolio boundary evidence.
supports: The portfolio contains Bright Stalk and Harvest Ridge
The initial 68% sale closed on July 1, 2021
Both projects continue to list Greencoat and EDPR owners

Bright Stalk and Harvest Ridge Wind Portfolio
afterImage.description: The Illinois Wind Portfolio comprises the 205 MW Bright Stalk wind farm in McLean County and the 200 MW Harvest Ridge wind farm in Douglas County. Schroders Greencoat-managed investors own 80% and EDP Renewables retains 20% following two closings in 2021. EDPR continues to manage the operating assets; the exact Greencoat funds, acquisition holdco and EDPR upstream holder are not publicly disclosed.
